facts.fact: 开场笑话：躲开铁路员工蹭车去上班，工作是教人朝乐团挥小棒，答案是“列车员／指挥”（conductors 一词两义）
facts.anchor: ‘I’m hiding from railway staff members to get a free journey into my job teaching people how to wave batons at orchestras.’ ‘Train conductors?’ ‘Yes.’

facts.fact: 被日历厂开除，理由“请假太多”：days off 既是请假又是日历上撕掉的日子
facts.anchor: I got fired from the calendar factory. Apparently I took too many days off.

facts.fact: 马戏团铲象粪的人向酒保抱怨浑身是屎，被问为何不辞职，答“离开演艺圈？！”
facts.anchor: It gets in my hair, in my beard, under my nails, everywhere.

facts.fact: 农夫带牧羊犬看兽医，兽医说只能“put down”（安乐死／放下来），因为它“实在太重”
facts.anchor: I’m afraid I’m going to have to put this dog down.

facts.fact: 请殡葬业者吃圣诞晚餐，问火鸡上浇什么，答“肉汁”（gravy），他要求对方“clarify”（澄清／澄清黄油）
facts.anchor: I said, ‘I’m going to have to ask you to clarify.’

facts.fact: 雇来的杂工只干了清单上第 1、3、5、7、9 项，因为他只做“零活”（odd jobs 双关奇数项）
facts.anchor: It turned out he only did odd jobs.

facts.fact: 宇航员最爱吃什么？Launch（发射／午餐 lunch 的谐音）
facts.anchor: What’s an astronaut’s favourite meal? Launch.

facts.fact: text 末尾孤立着一条脚注，讲“噪音是什么”，和本章内容对不上，像是前文某条笑话的残件
facts.anchor: * What was the noise, you ask? We can’t tell you, you’re not a monk.
